## Introduction

This page collects article-style writing that sits alongside the rest of the portfolio. The goal is simple: make analytical work feel readable, visual, and worth exploring.

Each piece is designed to be practical rather than ornamental. Some articles walk through experimental logic step by step. Others translate well-known research into a cleaner, more intuitive story.
